## What should change

## Why it fits gawa

gawa stays a typed bridge. See SPEC.md. Say which part of the spec this
touches, or why it does not change the protocol.

## Out of scope

A UI toolkit, a plugin system, and a CLI are out of scope. A breaking change
to an existing caller needs the maintainer's agreement before anyone builds it.
